thread:
anya: Heads-up — competitor BlueModel shipped a 'tiered routing + per-tenant pricing' feature this morning. A couple of pilots pinged me asking how soon we can match. Quick sync? Do we push per-route cost controls (billing-heavy) or keep momentum on our latency/cost-differentiators (prefetch caching, quantization)?

sam: Saw the announcement. Looks like routing UI + rules engine + billing tie-ins. Routing + UI is medium effort, billing integration is large.

maria: Two enterprise prospects asked for per-route controls this week. They explicitly said they'd trade some latency for lower spend. Sales pressure is real. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

felix: Curious whether this is parity or noise. If we rush a cheap parity play, we risk diverting resources from caching/quantization that improve unit economics for everyone.

anya: Good point. I'm thinking an MVP that avoids a full billing refactor: minimal API for route tagging, a rules-to-variant evaluation engine, and console + audit logs. Billing integration can be phased (reporting -> soft limits -> billing).

sam: That seems doable. We can map route tags to model variants (e.g., high-quality / standard / low-cost) without touching billing for now. Example rule prototype we could use in the PRD:

```json
{
  "route": "checkout-recommendations",
  "policy": [{"if": "latency_sensitive==false", "map_to": "low_cost_model"}, {"if": "customer_tier==enterprise", "map_to": "high_quality_model"}]
}
```

maria: Pilots will accept a phased approach. They also asked for per-route SLA overrides (e.g., opt-out of strict latency SLOs for certain routes). Can we scope that to non-critical routes initially?

jordan: SLA override requires per-route telemetry + enforcement hooks. For MVP we can provide a read-only console that shows expected latency/cost tradeoffs and a soft-override flag that only applies to routing selection (no hard enforcement).

anya: Proposed prioritization: 1) Route tagging + variant mapping API (2 sprints) — enables most pilot asks; 2) Console controls + audit logs (3 sprints) — customer-facing; 3) Billing integration and quota enforcement (Q2). Comments?

felix: Add guardrails: default routing policy should bias toward low-latency variants for live chat endpoints. Also add a regression test that verifies KV cache behavior with the mapped variants.

maria: I'll communicate phased approach to pilots and collect acceptance criteria. Need a short customer-facing PRD and sample acceptance tests.

sam: I'll draft the internal PRD and include an implementation plan for reusing rollout flags and canaries. Quick question: can we reuse existing feature-rollout infra for per-route rollouts?

anya: Yes — reuse rollout flags for phased exposure. Action items: Sam -> PRD by Friday; Felix -> spike on model-variant mapping + cache regression by Wednesday; Jordan -> proposal for logs/retention and soft-override UX by end of week. I'll coordinate with Sales. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — I will align pilots and push for signoffs on phased delivery.

anya: OK, we'll reconvene after those artifacts. Short thread but actionable. :eyes:
